prompt: Create an ultra-realistic luxury studio portrait of a young adult Black man seated confidently in a deep burgundy tufted leather wingback armchair with rolled arms and brass nailhead trim. He faces the camera directly with a calm, composed expression, relaxed posture, one hand resting on the chair arm and the other on his thigh. He has short neatly trimmed black hair, smooth natural skin tone, and sharp realistic facial detail. Dress him in a crisp white dress shirt, burgundy buttoned waistcoat, black satin tie, black trousers, and a gold wristwatch. Use a dark burgundy studio backdrop that blends with the leather chair for a refined monochrome luxury feel. Lighting should be professional editorial portrait lighting: soft key light from front-left, subtle fill, gentle highlights on the leather texture, natural catchlights in the eyes, realistic shadows, high dynamic range, polished but not overly retouched. Frame as a vertical three-quarter seated portrait from head to upper legs, centered composition, 2:3 aspect ratio, shallow depth of field, premium magazine cover quality, no text, no logo, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张超逼真的奢华影棚肖像，主角是 一位年轻的黑人男性，他自信地坐在深酒红色簇绒皮质高背扶手椅上，椅子带有卷边扶手和黄铜钉饰。他直视镜头，表情沉稳从容，姿态放松，一只手放在椅扶手上，另一只手放在大腿上。他留着修剪整齐的短黑发，肤色自然细腻，面部细节逼真。为他穿上 一件挺括的白色衬衫、酒红色纽扣马甲、黑色缎面领带、黑色西裤和一块金表。使用与皮椅色调融合的深 酒红色 影棚背景，营造出精致的单色奢华感。灯光应采用专业的编辑级肖像布光：左前方柔和的主光，微妙的补光，皮质纹理上的柔和高光，眼中自然的眼神光，真实的阴影，高动态范围，质感高级且不过度修图。构图为垂直的三分之二身坐姿肖像，从头部到大腿，居中构图，2:3 纵横比，浅景深，高级杂志封面质量，无文字，无 Logo，无水印。
